seo.ogDescription: Every website is structured around how people search for and choose a local service business.

h1: Websites built around how your customers choose you.

sections.subheading: Every plan runs on the same managed foundation — hosting, SEO, monthly updates — shaped around what actually gets someone in your industry to call, book or visit.

sections.heading: What do we build for local service businesses?
body: SynergyFirst Digital builds managed websites for local service businesses, with a dedicated page for each trade: garage door, tree service, roofing and exterior, plumbing, HVAC and electrical, and fencing, concrete and remodeling. Every website is hosted, maintained and supported for one monthly fee, with no upfront design fee.
Plans start at $249 per month with no activation fee, and every business can see a free, private preview before paying.

sections.heading: Choose your industry
sections.intro: Each industry page covers the problems we see most often, the features that matter for that kind of business, and how the process works.
